subject.title: fix(sweep): allow PR review lease comments

question: Should the scheduled review shard receive Pull requests write permission, with rollout completed under an explicit proof override and monitored post-merge validation?
rationale: The permission is necessary for PR timeline comments but expands a live GitHub App mutation boundary, and scheduled default-branch behavior cannot be positively demonstrated from this unmerged branch.

options.title: Approve monitored rollout
options.body: Confirm the App installation and Codex credential isolation, accept the scoped permission expansion, override the pre-merge proof gate, and validate the next normal PR-and-issue review run.

options.title: Pause for narrower design
options.body: Keep the review token read-only while moving lease/status publication to a separately write-authorized trusted job or another narrower architecture.

recommendation.title: Approve monitored rollout
recommendation.body: Confirm the App installation and Codex credential isolation, accept the scoped permission expansion, override the pre-merge proof gate, and validate the next normal PR-and-issue review run.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide workflow security-boundary and deployment-proof decision.
